name: United Breweries Ltd
about: United Breweries Limited (UBL) is engaged in the business of manufacture and sale of beer and non-alcoholic beverages. [1]
keyPoints:
Brand Portfolio
The Co markets its products under the flagship brands Kingfisher and Heineken. Some of the most popular brands in its portfolio include Kingfisher Premium, Kingfisher Ultra, Kingfisher Strong, Kingfisher Ultra Max, UB Export Lager, London Pilsner etc. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 63.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.3 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 9.73% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 96.5 to 117 days.
